name: bigslick
description: START HERE — the required 32-skill core of Big Slick, the open-source marketing distribution for Claude: positioning, ICP, copy, SEO, ads, CRO, pricing, attribution and reporting, plus the onboarding and context machinery every other Big Slick plugin depends on. The ten optional bigslick-* bundles add 217 more skills on top of this one; install them only when you need a specialty. All MIT or Apache-2.0 and redistributable.
